name: np-childs-format
description: Gate counts vs n for n up to 500 in the format of Childs et al. 2018 (Figs. 3/10): mean measured r over NumPy seeds 1-10, power-law fit, exact affine per-step counts; up to 3 weakest formulas removed per figure, never one of the 2 cheapest at any plotted n. 2026-11-08: X-Y-Z figures fit n = 5-11 (np-main + np-main-n9/-n11), Childs et al.'s 'every size from 5' rule; two-group and optimised figures keep their fits (no n = 9, 11 runs).

dirty_exception.reason: np-main-n9/-n11 were run at e42ff29 with one uncommitted change: the signature of pfseeds.load_runs (per_seed_keys), which pfcompare does not import; e42ff29 differs from np-main's 01d3c27 only by the plsimcount->pysimcount rename. Spot-checked by recomputing from committed code on 2026-11-08 (see fit-change-checks.md).
